g.text: How a finished render reaches the browser
Magic Hour's webhook and the browser's own polling race to the same shared finalize step
(via POST /api/transform) job submitted, saved as processing
(paused while the tab is hidden or the browser is offline)]
after() : once the response is already sent
not already checked in the last 60s
[the webhook was lost, or none is reachable locally]
The claim is exclusive: whichever path
arrives second finds the job claimed
(the file itself is copied into Cloudinary - see the storage diagram)
